title: Accountants in Paisley | Marsal Accountants
description: Independent accountants on Macdowall Street, PA3 2NB. Accounts, tax, payroll and bookkeeping for Paisley, Renfrewshire, Glasgow and Central Scotland.

sections.h2: A local firm with full-service support
sections.body: Marsal Accountants combines a Paisley office with cloud-based workflows, so you get local access when you need it and efficient turnaround when you do not. We work with sole traders, landlords, employers and limited companies.

Year-end accounts, Self Assessment, corporation tax, payroll and RTI, bookkeeping, management accounts, property income reporting, and VAT including Making Tax Digital. Fees are agreed upfront where possible, with unlimited advice on agreed day-to-day matters for eligible packages.
Many clients are in Paisley and Johnstone; others are based in Glasgow or wider Central Scotland. The same team, systems and deadlines apply wherever you trade.

faqs.question: Where are Marsal Accountants based in Paisley?
faqs.answer: Office 1.4, 1 Macdowall Street, Paisley PA3 2NB. Contact us to arrange a consultation or to discuss remote onboarding.

faqs.question: Do you only work with businesses in PA postcodes?
faqs.answer: No. We support clients across Renfrewshire, Glasgow and Central Scotland. Local meetings are available when they add value; much of our work is handled efficiently online and by phone.

faqs.question: How do I switch to Marsal from another accountant?
faqs.answer: We use a structured handover: you approve release of records from your previous adviser, we agree cut-over dates for filings and payroll where relevant, and we confirm what we need from you at each step.
